heroImageAlt: Illustration of the Lasuarindo Group team and activities
lead2: is an integrated enterprise operating across multiple strategic sectors.
body: We focus on innovation, sustainable growth, and delivering lasting value to communities and business partners through a solid, collaborative ecosystem.
valuesSub: The foundational principles guiding every action and strategic decision we make.

text.id: Menjunjung tinggi kejujuran, transparansi, dan etika dalam setiap tindakan dan keputusan.
text.en: Upholding the highest standards of honesty, transparency, and ethics in every endeavor.

text.id: Kami terus berinovasi dan beradaptasi untuk menciptakan solusi yang relevan dan bernilai.
text.en: Continuously innovating and adapting to deliver forward-looking, impactful solutions.

text.id: Kami percaya bahwa kolaborasi yang kuat menciptakan hasil yang lebih besar dan berkelanjutan.
text.en: Believing that strong, purpose-driven collaboration produces superior, lasting results.

text.id: Kami berkomitmen memberikan kualitas terbaik dan terus mendorong diri untuk melampaui standar.
text.en: Committed to excellence, constantly challenging ourselves to surpass industry benchmarks.

text.id: Kami berfokus pada kebutuhan pelanggan dan berupaya memberikan pengalaman terbaik.
text.en: Centering our clients and partners to create meaningful, transformative experiences.

text.id: Kami peduli terhadap lingkungan dan masyarakat dengan mengedepankan keberlanjutan.
text.en: Devoted to environmental responsibility and social sustainability across all operations.

strengthsBody: These values are not just guidelines, but our steadfast commitment to grow, create impact, and inspire the future.
founderQuote: "It is not about numbers, but about the meaning we build, the impact we generate, and the legacy we leave behind. Every step we take is an investment for generations to come."
founderBody1: For me, founding Lasuarindo Group was not merely about building a business — it is a journey of creating a purposeful ecosystem where individuals can flourish and contribute their finest work.
founderBody2: I believe great business starts from strong values — integrity, collaboration, and a relentless spirit to innovate for the greater good. With our visionary team, we are eager to elevate Lasuarindo Group to even higher heights.
commissionerQuote: "Trust is the bedrock of everything. Without uncompromising integrity and sincere commitment, any enterprise is merely a fragile edifice shaken by the tests of time."
commissionerCore: Trust is the foundation of everything.
commissionerBody1: As Commissioner of Lasuarindo Group, I witness immense potential in each step we take forward. This is not just about growing a company — it is about
commissionerBody2: I am immensely proud of our team growth and unwavering devotion to the shared values we built. With visionary leadership and a committed team, I am confident Lasuarindo Group will continue thriving.
networkLead: We grow alongside institutions, associations, and partners that trust the group's direction. The names below are part of our strategic network.
visionDesc: To become a premier integrated, innovative, and globally competitive business group dedicated to shaping a better, sustainable future.
missions: Develop resilient, well-diversified business portfolios across high-potential sectors.
Drive digital acceleration and embrace cutting-edge innovation across all operations.
Create enduring, sustainable value for shareholders, strategic partners, and society.
Champion robust corporate governance, ethical leadership, and environmental stewardship.
